name: PipeStreamr
description: WhatsApp (and more) via the PipeStreamr passthru. Outbound replies go through PipeStreamr's /api/v1/messages/send; inbound messages arrive as PipeStreamr webhooks. Point your PipeStreamr project webhook at <daemon>/webhook/pipestreamr.

settings.label: PipeStreamr integration ID
settings.help: The PipeStreamr integration UUID for this channel. Inbound webhooks are routed to this channel by matching it, and replies are sent back through it. Find it in PipeStreamr under the integration's settings.

settings.label: WhatsApp number (label)
settings.help: Optional — the WhatsApp number behind this integration, shown for reference. Routing uses the integration ID, not this number.

settings.label: Persona
settings.help: The persona that answers inbound messages on this channel. Leave blank to use the orchestrator-agent, which delegates to specialist personas as needed.

settings.label: Model
settings.help: Model the persona runs with. Leave blank for the daemon default.
